rawFindings.title: Forced inclusion overwrites existing projection operators
rawFindings.explanation: When a schema path is `select: false` and the query both forces it with `+path` and already has a projection entry for the same path, this unconditional assignment later sets `fields[path] = 1`. That overwrites non-boolean projections such as `$slice` that were added before `_applyPaths()` runs.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the guard so the forced inclusion only adds `fields[path] = 1` when the path is not already present, e.g. `if (false === exclude && keys.length > 1 && !~keys.indexOf(path))`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For a schema `{ many: { type: [String], select: false } }`, `Model.findOne().select('+many').where('many').slice(2)` now sends a projection of `{ many: 1 }` instead of `{ many: { $slice: 2 } }`, so the returned document contains the full array rather than two elements.
